'''Father Iwanicki''' is an [[ally]]. He first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Graveyard]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Evade]]
*+2 [[Horror check|Horror]]

You cannot be [[curse]]d.

==Mythos Source==

Father Iwanicki is a minor character in ''The Dreams in the Witch House'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1932).
